relevant_laws.quote: When the signal is circular green alone: Pedestrians facing such a signal may proceed across the highway within any marked or unmarked crosswalk, unless directed otherwise by another device as provided in NRS 484B.283 [NRS-484B-283-1d1, NRS-484B-283-1d2, NRS-484B-283-1d3, NRS-484B-283-1d4].
relevant_laws.notes: Frozen witness selects the straight pedestrian crosswalk route.
